title: D.T. Cox third graders bring the North Pole to the gym on Dec. 8
excerpt: The evening musical in Pontotoc falls between two morning performances for second graders. The high school’s Christmas concert opens the district’s December music calendar.
locality: Pontotoc City School District, including D.T. Cox Elementary School in Pontotoc, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Third graders at D.T. Cox Elementary School will perform their North Pole musical in the school gym Tuesday, Dec. 8, from 6 to 7 p.m. The school is at 304 Clark Street in Pontotoc.

The same Tuesday also brings the first of two second-grade performances on the city schools calendar. The group listed as Pod 1 performs from 9 to 10 a.m. Pod 2 has the same morning time two days later, on Thursday, Dec. 10. The gym location is confirmed for the third-grade evening show. The district’s two morning listings give times only.

Pontotoc High School’s Christmas concert is the week before, on Thursday, Dec. 3. The district has posted the date and has yet to list a start time or venue. Families with questions about the Dec. 8 evening performance can reach D.T. Cox at 662-489-2454.
